cards.title: It says what it is
cards.text: Its own user agent on every request, never a desktop browser's, and nothing about the person.

cards.title: One page per question
cards.text: A recipe or a map answer; no crawling, no shop pages, no logins.

cards.title: Takes your no
cards.text: robots.txt on every request, AI readers' groups too, and a page's own no-AI signals.

cards.title: What it keeps
cards.text: A recipe from a site in its table, published with your name and a link to you.

cards.title: Ask us to stop
cards.text: An issue on GitHub; a stop is honoured and its copies deleted.
